comments.author: Daedalus
comments.body_html: So I’m having an issue when this mod is installed that causes certain weapons like the Gornostay, MP7A1 and AK-74M to have their weapon models be displaced from the animations whenever they are modified (like a reload, attaching an attachment mid-raid, etc.) I had to uninstall the mod to stop it from happening, which is a shame.

comments.author: Choccy Milk
comments.body_html: hmmm, that is a very odd behaviour, I will take a look at it. the mod shouldn’t really displaces the model whenever attaching a new attachment or a new mag. Does it happen on any other animation aside from reload and attaching attachment?

comments.author: Daedalus
comments.body_html: Not that I could tell. For example, folding the stock on the MP7A1 didn’t cause it.

comments.author: Daedalus

comments.author: Choccy Milk
comments.body_html: I have tested and it seems it is a weird side effect that came with it. My best guess is it has something to do with the bundle of the mentioned weapons, I will try to make a list that will prevent the animator from updating when certain weapon is equipped. In the meantime if you do encounter more weapons that behaves like the MP7A1 or the AK-74M you can go to the mod github issue

comments.author: Choccy Milk
comments.body_html:
IMPORTANT INFO:

There is a bug that is an unintended side effect of this mod, it mainly affects weapon that can use bipods. If you are using any weapons that supports bipod, SV-98 or M60 for example, performing a mag in or equipping/unequipping attachment will cause the bipod to be VISUALLY CLOSED, however this is only a visual thing and you can fix it by toggling it on and off again. This happened due to how bipods function.
